claims: Over 3.1 million bottles of eye drops manufactured by K.C. Pharmaceuticals have been recalled in April 2026.
The recall is due to potential lack of sterility.
The recalled products include various artificial tears and lubricants.
The recalled products are sold under store brands like CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, and Kroger.
The recalled products pose a risk of infection.
The 2026 recall reason is lack of assurance of sterility.
Lack of assurance of sterility may lead to infection.
Affected products include Dry Eye Relief.
Affected products include Artificial Tears Sterile Lubricant.
Affected products include Sterile Eye Drops Original Formula.
Affected products include Redness Lubricant.
Affected retailers include CVS Health, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Kroger, Publix, H-E-B, Harris Teeter, Target, Dollar General.
The FDA list of recalled products includes Walgreens UPC 3-11917-20167-2.
CVS Health affected products include Multi-Action Relief.
CVS Health affected products include Lubricant Gel.
CVS Health affected products include Lubricant Eye Drops.
Leader & TopCare various Sterile Eye Drops are on the FDA list of recalled products.
H-E-B affected products include A.C. Eye Drops.
H-E-B affected products include Lubricant Eye Drops.
H-E-B affected products include Original Eye Drops.
Foster & Thrive NDC 70677-1160-1 is on the FDA list of recalled products.
The FDA has classified this as a Class II recall.
